begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma bintrunc_numeral:
  "(take_bit :: nat \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int) (numeral k) x = of_bool (odd x) + 2 * (take_bit :: nat \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int) (pred_numeral k) (x div 2)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. take_bit (numeral k) x = of_bool (odd x) + 2 * take_bit (pred_numeral k) (x div 2)<\STATESEP>by (simp add: numeral_eq_Suc take_bit_Suc mod_2_eq_odd)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma neg_num_bintr:
  "(- numeral x :: 'a::len word) = word_of_int (take_bit LENGTH('a) (- numeral x))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. - numeral x = word_of_int (take_bit LENGTH('a) (- numeral x))<\STATESEP>by transfer simp<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>ML \<open>
  fun is_refl \<^Const_>\<open>Pure.eq _ for x y\<close> = (x = y)
    | is_refl _ = false;

  fun signed_dest_wordT \<^Type>\<open>word \<^Type>\<open>signed T\<close>\<close> = Word_Lib.dest_binT T
    | signed_dest_wordT T = Word_Lib.dest_wordT T

  fun typ_size_of t = signed_dest_wordT (type_of (Thm.term_of t));

  fun num_len \<^Const_>\<open>Num.Bit0 for n\<close> = num_len n + 1
    | num_len \<^Const_>\<open>Num.Bit1 for n\<close> = num_len n + 1
    | num_len \<^Const_>\<open>Num.One\<close> = 1
    | num_len \<^Const_>\<open>numeral _ for t\<close> = num_len t
    | num_len \<^Const_>\<open>uminus _ for t\<close> = num_len t
    | num_len t = raise TERM ("num_len", [t])

  fun unsigned_norm is_neg _ ctxt ct =
  (if is_neg orelse num_len (Thm.term_of ct) > typ_size_of ct then let
      val btr = if is_neg
                then @{thm neg_num_bintr} else @{thm num_abs_bintr}
      val th = [Thm.reflexive ct, mk_eq btr] MRS transitive_thm

      (* will work in context of theory Word as well *)
      val ss = simpset_of (@{context} addsimps @{thms bintrunc_numeral} delsimps @{thms take_bit_minus_one_eq_mask})
        (* TODO: completely explicitly determined simpset *)
      val cnv = simplify (put_simpset ss ctxt) th
    in if is_refl (Thm.prop_of cnv) then NONE else SOME cnv end
    else NONE)
  handle TERM ("num_len", _) => NONE
       | TYPE ("dest_binT", _, _) => NONE
\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>simproc_setup
  unsigned_norm ("numeral n::'a::len word") = \<open>unsigned_norm false\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>simproc_setup
  unsigned_norm_neg0 ("-numeral (num.Bit0 num)::'a::len word") = \<open>unsigned_norm true\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>simproc_setup
  unsigned_norm_neg1 ("-numeral (num.Bit1 num)::'a::len word") = \<open>unsigned_norm true\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma minus_one_norm:

 1. - 1 = word_of_nat (2 ^ LENGTH('a) - 1)<\STATESEP>by (simp add:of_nat_diff)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemmas minus_one_norm_num =
  minus_one_norm [where 'a="'b::len bit0"] minus_one_norm [where 'a="'b::len0 bit1"]<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>context
